name: biological sex
rationale: Sex/gender columns; values male/female in every member.

name: age
rationale: Age of the subject at sampling. Reference event never stated, so not inferred as age at diagnosis.

name: organism part
rationale: Anatomical source of the sample (blood, colonic mucosa, vastus lateralis, intestine).

name: cell type
rationale: Values name a cell population (primary islet cells).

name: specimen type
rationale: Kind of specimen (biopsy), not its anatomical source.

name: subject identifier
rationale: Identifiers of individuals. EFO has `individual` but no identifier class; the column names the individual, it is not one.

name: sample identifier
rationale: Identifiers of samples.

name: ethnic group
rationale: Race/ethnicity or population of origin.

name: disease
rationale: Values name the subject's diagnosis (incl. healthy/control), sometimes with stage or complication detail kept verbatim. Pooling is lossless: every value is still a diagnosis.

name: disease duration
rationale: Time since diagnosis, any disease; the disease itself is carried by the disease column.

name: treatment
rationale: Administered intervention (drug, placebo, meal test, none, trial arm name). `treatment` is the most specific term true of all members; `compound based treatment` would be false for MMTT. Arm names (MK2206 Arm / Control Arm) still identify the regimen, so they pool here.

name: timepoint (since start of treatment)
rationale: Weeks since start of biologic therapy (golimumab week 0/6; vedolizumab 0W/14W/54W).

name: timepoint (relative to mixed meal tolerance test)
rationale: Before vs 1 hour after a meal challenge. Different reference event from therapy start.

name: timepoint (hours, reference not stated)
rationale: 0 hr / 24 hrs; reference event not stated in metadata.

name: timepoint (coded T1-T3)
rationale: Coded visits with no interval in metadata; not convertible to the hours variable.

name: study day
rationale: Day part of D2_ZT_15:30.

name: zeitgeber time
rationale: Circadian clock part of D2_ZT_15:30.

name: estrogen receptor status
rationale: 0/1 coded in both members.

name: progesterone receptor status
rationale: `pr` and `pgr status`.

name: HER2 status
rationale: 0/1 coded.

name: hormone receptor status
rationale: `hr`: ER or PR positive. Broader than either receptor term; EFO has no combined term.

name: PAM50 subtype
rationale: Basal/HER2/LumA/LumB are breast carcinoma subtypes from the PAM50 classifier.

name: receptor-defined subtype
rationale: TN vs LUM. Different classification system from PAM50, so a different variable.

name: histological type
rationale: IDC/ILC/other.

name: tumor size
rationale: Units unstated: values imply cm in GSE237290 and mm in GSE58984. Pools after conversion.

name: tumor grade
rationale: I/II/III. EFO has only grade instances (MONDO tumor grade 1..4), no grade category; `disease staging` is stage, not grade.

name: nodal status
rationale: 0 = node negative, 1 = node positive: a coarsening of N stage.

name: number of positive lymph nodes
rationale: A count. Derivable into nodal status but not equivalent to it, so not pooled.

name: pathological complete response
rationale: pCR/No pCR and 0/1/-1.

name: neoadjuvant response index
rationale: NRI score.

name: stromal tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes
rationale: Percent stromal TILs. GSE237290 `til` states no compartment; the usual convention (International TILs Working Group scores stromal TILs) is assumed and flagged.

name: gc (meaning not stated)
rationale: 0/1; the abbreviation is not explained in the metadata.

name: overall survival time
rationale: Units unstated (years by magnitude).

name: recurrence-free interval
rationale: RFI does not count death as an event; RFS does. Different endpoints, so not pooled with rfs_time.

name: recurrence
rationale: event.rfi 0/1 and recurrence No/Yes.

name: distant disease-free survival time
rationale: Units unstated (days by magnitude).

name: septic shock
rationale: shock Yes/No and shock_status shock/no_shock/control.

name: sepsis severity
rationale: no_shock / fluid_responsive / vasopressor-responsive / control.

name: infection type
rationale: viral / bacterial / viral_bacterial / no_source.

name: 30-day mortality
rationale: Fixed 30-day window, so not pooled with follow_up_status (window not stated).

name: follow-up status
rationale: Survived/Died.

name: inflammation status
rationale: inflamed/uninflamed sample site. No general inflammation term in the allowlisted pool.

name: Mayo score
rationale: UC disease-activity index, 0-12.

name: Nancy histological index
rationale: Different instrument from the Mayo score, so a different variable.

name: UC activity status
rationale: Active/Inactive part of a combined column.

name: sample age (meaning unclear)
rationale: `sample_age(y)` 1/2/3, alongside a separate patient_age. Probably storage time; not stated.

name: QC status
rationale: include/EXCLUDE.

name: body mass index
rationale: kg/m2 (ungrounded unit).

name: HbA1c
rationale: Reported in % (NGSP) and mmol/mol (IFCC); convertible.

name: fasting glucose
rationale: mmol/L in one series, mg/dL ('Glucose (AC)', before meals) in the other; convertible.

name: clinical phenotype notes
rationale: Free-text medical-record descriptions.

name: urinary albumin to creatinine ratio
rationale: Split out of GSE189007 `phenotype`, where it appears as 'UARC: <value> (mg/g)'.

name: recruitment site
rationale: Hospital names.
